_comment: Known, accepted gaps — ONE exception registry for tools/lint-skills.rb (E9.2), covering both rule families: converter-gate gaps (rule ids like 'parity-gate') and byte-budget exceptions (rule ids 'skill-md-bytes', 'ref-bytes:<file>.md', 'pre-read-width'; budgets: SKILL.md <= 20480B, refs/*.md <= 32768B, mandatory pre-read <= 3 files). Each entry shows as a tracked WARN (not a CI failure) and MUST carry a non-empty justification — a blank reason fails the lint. This list is a RATCHET: fix/diet the skill (relocate detail into phase-scoped refs — tableau-to-sigma is the template), then DELETE the entry. Never add an entry for a NEW skill — new skills start inside budget.
